items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Yeah, it looks like Sa-ee all right.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was gonna say he looks big like Zooty Singleton, but I knew it couldn't be Zooty,
so I was trying to think. Yeah, it looks like Sa-ee all right. He looks bigger then than he is now.
Remember the fella that's called Battle Axe? That's him right there. He heard the name on guitar.
